name: Pipeliners - Blog Audit 2026-09-29
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-09-29

# Summary
Audit of all 63 blog posts (51 published, 11 draft, 1 private) on Sep 29, 2026, built from a database read, a live crawl and an external link status check. Main output: `blog-audit-2026-09-29.csv` with words, SEO title, title and meta lengths, schema types, Article schema, featured image, internal links in and out, 90-day GSC impressions and flags.

# Key findings
- 32 posts had no Article or BlogPosting schema; 12 had no featured image.
- 20 had fewer than 3 contextual internal links; 11 were orphans (no post or page links to them).
- 11 rows are retired posts that now 301 to a merge target.
- 9 posts used "here" anchors; 7 were thin (under 800 words).
- House style: "Pipeliners USA" in 7 titles and in the body of 9 posts.
- Minor: 2 posts typed AboutPage, 2 with body images missing alt, 1 heading skip, 1 private post that 404s publicly.

# Decisions and status
- Article schema for posts that lacked it was added Oct 16 (per the change log and the Oct 15 SEO check).

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `blog-audit-2026-09-29.csv`: the audit.
- `ext_status.tsv`, `live/status.tsv`, `checkurls.txt`, `urls.txt`: link and URL status checks.
- Saved HTML, JSON, PHP, Python and shell scripts: not summarized.
